title: 228 L 5 Star Direct Cool Single Door Refrigerator (RDC260A)
description: Voltas Beko 5-Star Direct Cool Refrigerator offers superior energy efficiency with its 5-star rating. It features Fresh Box Technology for lasting freshness, Quick Freeze for rapid cooling, adjustable toughened glass shelves for flexible storage, and a base drawer for added convenience. Ideal for modern homes seeking performance and style.
